# PickupLocations

What the Delivery section shows for Pick up: a heading, how many stores have stock, and a choice list with each store’s address, readiness and distance.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/pickuplocations)

## Usage

```tsx
<PickupLocations locations={locations} value={storeId} onChange={setStoreId} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `locations` | `PickupLocation[]` | { id, name, address, ready?, distance? } |
| `value / onChange` | `string / (id) => void` | The chosen store. |
| `name` | `string` | Shared name of the radios. Default "pickup". |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `PickupLocations.module.css`
- `PickupLocations.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/checkout/CheckoutProvider.tsx`](../CheckoutProvider.tsx)
- [`src/labels.ts`](../../labels.ts)
- [`src/lib/money.ts`](../../lib/money.ts)
- [`src/primitives/ChoiceList`](../../primitives/ChoiceList)
- [`src/primitives/Collapsible`](../../primitives/Collapsible)
- [`src/primitives/Radio`](../../primitives/Radio)
- [`src/types.ts`](../../types.ts)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
